title: Se päour d'umble / Diex (anonymous, Ivrea Codex)
desc: Anonymous, Se päour d'umble / Diex. 3 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Tenor), each on its own staff. Transcribed from the original mensural notation at the original pitch; note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), a perfect value written with a dot. The tenor is a chant melody laid out in a repeated rhythm.
cr: From Measuring Polyphony (measuringpolyphony.org, ed. Karen Desmond). Licence: CC BY 3.0.

Ains vueil miex mes jorns fe- nir que cou- verte . a- mour m'o- ci- e, que vivre et ma vi- e en- tre los jo- yeus ha- ïr.
